messages:
deploy-bot: starting broadcast deploy to prod — services: runtime, api, console. commit=9f4b2a1 tag=release-2.4.1 change-window=now. wave=simultaneous. expected_duration=~6m

emma: oncall — watching metrics and logs, will alert if error rate >1% :eyes:

tony: runtime-eng — warmup complete, KV cache preloaded on pool-a. ready for traffic.

deploy-bot: runtime -> queued -> deploying to pool-a (gpu-optim).

li: api-eng — kicking off DB migration script (schema v2). ETA ~30s, running in canary.

deploy-bot: runtime: HEALTHY after deploy (120s). p50 latency +8ms, p95 flat.

deploy-bot: api canary -> failed (502 gateway). will auto-suspend canary and report logs :rotating_light:

li: attaching error snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
upstream response timeout while reading response header from upstream
service: api v2.4.1
```

sara: api-eng — seeing ingress timeout; migration may be touching long-running queries. rolling back canary to previous tag and pinning until we debug. @emma please start rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: api: rollback initiated by sara -> target_tag=release-2.4.0 status=rolling_back. watch rollout events.

matt: console-eng — console deployed cleanly, smoke tests green :white_check_mark: pushing traffic.

deploy-bot: api: rollback completed. instances=3 healthy. pin applied -> release=2.4.0. runtime and console remain at 2.4.1.

emma: created ticket PROD-1234 for post-deploy investigation (migration script + ingress timeouts). holding api re-deploy until root cause confirmed. link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PROD-1234

tony: runtime-eng — runtime stable, we'll keep enhanced metrics for 15m.

emma: summary: partial success. runtime+console = 2.4.1, api pinned to 2.4.0. follow-up: debug migration + run incremental canary once migration script is fixed. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-rollback

sara: noted. pushing logs and reproducer to the ticket. we'll coordinate a narrow change window for a safe re-roll later. :thumbsup:
